description: Fetch a URL and audit its response headers in one pass: security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy) with a score, PLUS its CORS policy (the probe sends a foreign Origin header and flags wildcard-origin + credentials combinations and arbitrary-origin reflection). Header-level checks on a single response — for server/TLS-level checks use ssl_cert_check or ssl_labs_grade instead.
name: security_headers_audit
